name: DevSecOps Pipeline & Security Automation

on:
  push:
    branches: [ "main", "master", "dev" ]
  pull_request:
    branches: [ "main", "master" ]

jobs:
  secops-pipeline:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      # 1. Checkout Code
      - name: Checkout Repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      # 2. Gate 1: SAST (Static Application Security Testing using Semgrep)
      - name: Gate 1 - Run SAST (Semgrep)
        uses: semgrep/semgrep-action@v1
        with:
          config: auto

      # 3. Gate 2: Dependency Scan tailored for Node.js (Juice Shop)
      - name: Gate 2 - Run Dependency Scan (npm audit)
        run: |
          npm audit --audit-level=high || true

      # 4. Gate 3: Secrets Scanning using Gitleaks
      - name: Gate 3 - Run Secrets Scan (Gitleaks)
        uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@v2
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      # 5. Build Docker Image
      - name: Build Docker Image
        run: |
          echo "Waiting for Member 1's Dockerfile setup..."

      # 6. Gate 4: Container Image Scanning using Trivy
      - name: Gate 4 - Run Container Scan (Trivy)
        uses: aquasecurity/trivy-action@master
        with:
          image-ref: 'bkimminich/juice-shop:latest'
          format: 'table'
          exit-code: '1'
          severity: 'CRITICAL,HIGH'
